retrieval_policy.authority: Primary issuer filings hosted by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
retrieval_policy.reproducible_route: Open the filing index by accession number, then open document sequence 1 (Form 10-K).
retrieval_policy.redistribution: Only project-authored transcriptions and derived outputs are committed. No issuer PDF, workbook, or filing copy is redistributed.
retrieval_policy.automation_note: Automated retrieval must identify the client and follow the SEC fair-access policy. The offline verifier does not make network requests.
